description: Demand, availability and consumption of the Spanish electricity grid between 2007-2019 and forecast for recharging electric vehicles in the Spanish electricity grid by 2020-2023 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Alejandro Cama Pinto. 1) Resume_Raw_Data.xlsx Is the resume of the primary data that was extracted from the Spanish electricity grid database in Megawatts. Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
